purpose: Sanitized model of durable interests, digital services, and media/technology patterns derived from the local iCloud mail index. Subscription/marketing evidence is treated more cautiously than user-authored or transactional evidence.

current_intensity_signals.note: Message counts are not a measure of importance by themselves; they are included to show repeated exposure/engagement and must be interpreted with sender type.
interpretation: GitHub volume is dominated by 2026 repository/security/project notifications and is strong evidence of intensive current coding/project activity.
Patreon volume is unusually concentrated in Skyrim/modding creators and is strong supporting evidence for the existing Skyrim-modding priority.
Research-platform volume supports an ongoing paid-study/side-income interest, but individual invitations do not prove participation.
Retailer counts may reflect transactions, recommendations, shipping, and marketing; they are not automatically interests.

skyrim_and_modding.pattern: Skyrim modding is one of the clearest and most persistent current interests in the archive, independently matching the user's known projects.

patreon_creator_signals.note: Counts are message volume from creator/Patreon-related mail and can include post notifications, billing, and platform activity.

agent_implications: Skyrim-related retrieval should expect the user to follow individual creators and releases closely, not just broad game news.
Creator/version provenance can matter when analyzing mod compatibility, design influence, or update history.
A future following-feed or mod-watch subsystem would likely have high personal utility.

pc_gaming.evidence: Steam wishlist/sale and account activity is substantial in 2026.
pc_gaming.caveat: Wishlist presence is evidence of interest, not ownership or completion.

online_fiction_and_reading.ebook_workflow: Repeated e-book/Kindle delivery and forwarding behavior supports an active reading habit and use of email as an e-book transport/archive channel.
online_fiction_and_reading.caveat: Notification volume can represent watched threads/stories rather than active reading of every update.

lego_and_brick_collecting.pattern: Repeated LEGO Ideas, Rebrickable, third-party brick/minifigure, and direct product-availability/purchase correspondence support a durable brick-building/collecting interest.
agent_implications: Separate official LEGO, custom-build/reference material, and third-party/bootleg minifigure tracking rather than collapsing them into one retailer feed.
Product availability/release tracking may be more useful than generic marketing summaries.

cooking_home_and_diy.user_authored_evidence: A 2022 personal needs/gift list included cookware, knife storage, thermometers, bulk pantry containers, mason jars for canning/pickling/spice blends, a Dutch oven, grill/air-fryer equipment, drill/socket tools, and lumber for a table project.
cooking_home_and_diy.transactional_support: Later household purchasing supports continued home/kitchen/organization activity, though some purchases may belong to the household rather than the user personally.
cooking_home_and_diy.agent_implication: When helping with meals/home projects, favor practical equipment-aware planning and do not assume every craft/decor purchase is the user's own hobby.

paid_research_and_side_income.interpretation: The repeated multi-platform pattern is strong evidence of interest in flexible paid research/focus-group opportunities as side income or occasional participation.
paid_research_and_side_income.caution: A study invitation or match is not proof that the user qualified, participated, or was paid.

current_ai_coding_and_automation_ecosyst.pattern: 2026 account, repository, usage, and service correspondence strongly supports active experimentation with AI-assisted coding, cloud compute, integrations, and automation.

laptop.fact: Purchased a refurbished Dell Latitude 5520 (2021, Core i5-1145G7, 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD) in May 2026.

phone.fact: Personally addressed accessory purchases are consistent with an iPhone 11 in March 2026.
phone.caveat: Accessories do not prove the active handset, so this remains medium confidence.

gaming_hardware.fact: Repeated Nintendo Switch 2 accessory purchases support a household Switch 2 by May 2026.
gaming_hardware.caveat: Household purchase evidence does not prove exclusive personal ownership.

cloud_and_privacy_services: Mullvad VPN 30-day subscription purchased in September 2026.
device_and_service_history_2026.mobile_service: Transactional mail supports a Spectrum mobile/service relationship after a number-transfer workflow from AT&T in June 2026.

digital_workflow_patterns.email_as_transport: Frequently forwards links, scans, receipts, resumes, documents, software/project information, and e-books between personal, school, and work contexts.
digital_workflow_patterns.self_forwarding: At least 29 Sent Messages are self-forwards or cross-account transport rather than interpersonal correspondence.
digital_workflow_patterns.troubleshooting: Support correspondence shows a methodical tendency to reproduce issues, test across devices or conditions, describe what has already been tried, and escalate with evidence.
digital_workflow_patterns.records_orientation: Email is used not only for communication but as a lightweight receipt, confirmation, and document-transfer archive.

strong: Repeated behavior across multiple senders and months
Known project/activity overlap with user-stated interests
weak: A single accessory purchase as proof of device ownership

exclusions: Raw purchase details, prices, addresses, payment/account identifiers, security artifacts, and sensitive private correspondence are not retained.
